about: THE ntfy.sh push budget, declared once. Every sender on the home IP reads THIS file instead of
carrying its own copy of the numbers: edge-host scripts/lib-notify.sh (bash), trade-data
service/adapters/ntfy_client.py (python, in the service container), mattpc-llm-stack
monitoring/lib-notify.ps1 (PowerShell, the llm box). Canonical copy: edge-host
policy/ntfy-policy.json. The others are BYTE-IDENTICAL copies at the same path, checked daily
by mcp scripts/lint_script_parity.py; each repo's CI runs policy/ntfy-policy.cases.json through
its own library and pins this file by sha256 (LF-normalised) in that cases file, so an edit to
one copy fails that repo's CI. To change the policy: edit here, update policy_sha256 in the
cases file (and the cases the change moves), then copy BOTH files byte-for-byte into the other
two repos in the same round.
WHY: ntfy.sh gives an anonymous publisher 250 messages per UTC day PER SOURCE IP, shared by
Alertmanager, these libraries, Windmill, Grafana and the llm box. 2026-09-30..10-04 it was spent
by midday five days running and every real page 429'd.

quota.reserve_note: an ordinary push may not spend the last `reserve` messages of the UTC day; read from the destination (GET <base>/v1/account -> stats.messages_remaining). A probe that cannot answer is BLIND and blind fails OPEN: a lost page is worse than a noisy one.

reserve_exempt.am-heartbeat-watch: pager health: 'EDGE PAGER DOWN' is the page the reserve is kept FOR. A low quota is when Alertmanager's own heartbeat 429s, so holding this page to the digest would hide the outage exactly when it is happening; the episode stamp already limits it to one push per episode.
reserve_exempt.notify-canary: pager health: 'DELIVERY CANARY FAILED' says the paging path is broken; it fires at most once per drill, and a drill fails most often when the quota is short.

publisher_cap.counted_from: the send ledger (layout.ledger_dir): one line per ACCEPTED push

exempt.trade-data-market: decision-tape trading signals on their own topic: 50-88 accepted per day measured 2026-10-19..23 from /var/lib/edge-notify/sent, so a cap of 40 would drop real signals mid-session. Bounded by the reserve instead (ntfy_client, 2026-10-14).

night.note: start inclusive, end exclusive. A p2 inside the window is deferred to the 07:00 ET flush, where the replay budget (reserve) applies. Only a sender with a flush defers (edge-host lib-notify, trade-data via the bind-mounted state dir); the llm box has none and pushes.

p1.note: wake the operator: its own DND-overriding topic, never capped, never held. It is what the reserve is FOR. Nothing defaults to p1.

p2.note: ops attention: order is cap -> night defer -> reserve -> push. A hold needs somewhere to land (digest / held log); with none it pushes.

p3.note: digest material: appended to the daily 08:00 digest, never pushed on its own; with no digest to write it pushes at low priority.

layout.state_dir: /var/lib/edge-notify (edge-host + the bind-mount in trade-data's containers); C:\llama\monitoring\state on the llm box
